title: Draft board at Penn Station
summary: Back in New York he was summoned for the draft, ordered to Pennsylvania Station, and subjected to an exam.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: Now, I'm in New York and I was saddened about affairs. Now, I said, well, I guess I gotta sort of remass myself and/plan out a of what I must do.

Well, the next two days I had a card to appear at a certain school for draft. I said, 'Well, sir, I don't think you need me.' He said 'Yes, sir, you can tell me anything you want to but you appear at the Pennsylvania Station with enough clothes for three days and a toothbrush and such' and so I said, yes, sir.

So, I'm there. I go down there and I said, well, sir -- and he said, that's all right, you just get on. And they were so terrible. He said, take your pants off and I said man, what is he doing in here? I said, I was trying to tell these people that I'm -- the other man said, 'Well, he was standing up wasn't he?'
